findings.title: QE-R7C-07 stays open for shortened executed answers: in weeks a review closed while no run was reported, late runs reported done but shorter than prescribed are treated as already read, so the recorded-answer re-plan does not fire and the stale projection stays VALID
findings.whyDelta: R7B2-FREEZE-1 is recorder-independent on all 280 cells of p6-x5. FREEZE-2 fails 224, which include these 28. Phase 6 did not introduce them, and its fix does not reach them.
findings.origin: unreadRunWeeks marks a WEEK_EVIDENCE week unread only when every run gate its review recorded is non-executed and the evidence reducer now reads an executed run gate (ADVANCE, EARNED or REGRESS) for that week. Shortened runs read HOLD, so the week counts as read. Its late runs stay in the 'read' record, and answeredOnRecord's window guard ('a run the stored plan read in the window') returns false. aboveFactsCeiling finds nothing credited because every window session has an executed report.
findings.mechanismEvidence: Instrumented isolated copy (p6-i-instrument.mjs, p6-i-cell.mjs). GEN week 7, g=0, RV, every gap run done at 60 %, clinical substitution, cleared, plain review day 3. Weeks 0-3 recorded LONG/EASY HOLD and still read HOLD; unread = [4,5,6]; the runs of 2026-11-22..29 (arrived on day 2 of week 7) count as read in the window; KEEP VALID QUALITY:34/LONG:60 (out/p6-i-cell.SHORT60.txt). The same runs at full dose read ADVANCE, unread = [0..6], and the re-plan fires (out/p6-i-cell.EXEC.txt).

findings.title: The reach of the recorded-answer re-plan is wider than the request states and changes Property B's scope
items: Timely reviewed paths untouched: 15/15 scenarios identical, no recorded re-plan (p6-x2).

Never-reviewed reporters: once the intake run leaves the 30-day window (week 5 in every probe), each week's first decision re-plans from the facts. With no deviation this only turns placeholder loads into the logged loads. With deviations it is more conservative than FREEZE-2 and than the reviewed path (GEN with a missed easy run each week: week 9 LONG 60, reviewed path 70, FREEZE-2 75; p6-x2b).

KEEP-only windows behave as never-reviewed: the request's 'does not fire: a skipped single review after reviewed weeks' holds only when those reviews anchored the week (MODIFY); after KEEP reviews it fires (the P51 case). The handoff wording is accurate; the request's bullet is not.

Habitual late reporter (every run reported on day 1 of the next week, after the week's review): from week 5 FREEZE-3 plans more than FREEZE-2, never beyond the same facts on time. R10K equals the timely path from week 7; GEN stays one quality-ladder step behind. A Saturday-only late reporter is identical on both freezes (p6-x4).

No recorded re-plan rewrote history (p6-x6). Same-role raises against the replaced plan: 1 conditional week-9 long run 60 -> 65, below FREEZE-2 (75) and the reviewed path (70). Role changes: 41, all quality -> easy.

G01 grid A: 8 rows change, not 4. 4 verdicts go OK_INDEPENDENT -> OK_HOLD_LIKE_REVIEWED_MISS; 4 more rows change their MISS/UNREP plans with the same verdict (e.g. RHM taper g=6: QUALITY 37 half-marathon-specific / LONG 55 -> QUALITY 27 threshold / LONG 45).
QE-R7C-05 now passes qe-e4's two batch-independence checks (81/81; FREEZE-2 79/81), but the handoff still lists it as an open residual.
findings.routing: SSCTR: accept or reject the change of Property B's scope; correct the disclosures (request bullet, G01 row count, QE-R7C-05). Not blocking: deterministic and conservative, no safety defect found.

findings.title: After a direct answer the recorded-answer re-plan fires again later in the answer week and can raise next week's VALID conditional doses above FREEZE-2's and above the week's own review
findings.actual: p6-x7, 224 cells (direct answer day 1 or 2, then plain reviews daily and the week's review). FREEZE-3 makes 130 more recorded re-plans than FREEZE-2 (C9's uncredited set grows as answer-week runs elapse with no report); 64 cells differ. In 20 cells next week's conditional doses rise above FREEZE-2's. Full-dose answers: quality 43 -> 48 or 38 -> 41, which the week's review then confirms. Known stops: EASY 15/15 -> 20/20 (the single-run ceiling); in 6 cells this is above what the week's review then plans (15/15/15), VALID from day 4 until that review. Uncrediting the elapsed easy runs gives a higher dose than crediting them at 15, because the dose then comes from the ceiling.
findings.consumerShield: C9's consumer condition does not literally apply: it covers an answer that leaves answer-week sessions elapsed before it, and the 07:00 answer left none. Bounded by the single-run ceiling; corrected by the week's review.

The choice-ASK carrier assumes a client that, per C2, does not apply a REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION result's proposal. QE-R7C-10 stands on the clinical carriers (substitution with pain, clinical return report) alone.
